reported_design_fact: 4 forest sites, 12 nights; 18 traps/night = 3 each for 5 colours and dark; 3295 arthropods; only 5 dark arrival timestamps recorded
unresolved_gate: Author dataset DOI 10.34894/SNKXWK identified via KNAW; original per-trap means/variances and access not yet retrieved; timing analysis has no effective dark comparator
screening_note: Four Dutch forest locations and 12 nights with LED camera traps. Original paper confirms an unlit treatment for catch counts. Dark-control times were scarce. Verify capture denominators.

reported_design_fact: Moth Helicoverpa and spider Drassodes response timing; skylight polarization also measured
unresolved_gate: Verify field versus experimental arena, separate species and physical light units; no capture census
screening_note: Tests activity of Helicoverpa and Drassodes under crepuscular lighting and measures the polarized sky. Check outdoor allocation, ambient comparator and eligibility of activity duration versus navigation.

reported_design_fact: 144 cricket nymphs tracked >38000 video-hours; overall activity and predation null, burrow transition frequency lower
unresolved_gate: Identify real illumination allocation/burrow independence; video-hours not independent lamps; preprint status
screening_note: Experimental light or control was applied to wild cricket burrows, with continuous individual video. Check units, night-specific activity metrics and clustering.

reported_design_fact: Within-streetlight high versus low light rotated by night; nearby dark sites; lower attraction at dimmed lights
unresolved_gate: Original response data available on request; dark site versus lit not necessarily randomized; estimate high-low and lit-dark separately
screening_note: Streetlights alternate high/low output across nights and dark sites are also sampled. Verify which comparisons control for site and what was independently varied.

reported_design_fact: Desert, unshielded/shielded/recessed/dark; 5 nights over 2 seasons; 7301 aerial arthropods excluding tiny dipterans; 7159 tiny dipterans; ground pitfall null reported
unresolved_gate: Find exact light-installation count, per-arm site-night means and SD/covariance; keep aerial/pitfall separate; 4171 tiny dipterans in 2 traps on May 5
screening_note: Three lit treatments and dark controls were deployed in the Chihuahuan Desert in spring and summer; the two trapping strata should be kept separate.

reported_design_fact: 3D flight tracking under colour/contrast/intensity manipulations
unresolved_gate: Check actual arena/lighting and sample identities; no count/census endpoint established
screening_note: Light intensity, structure and contrast varied for wild-caught moths tracked in three dimensions. Check arena setting, dark/background arms and comparability of initiation counts to flight metrics.

reported_design_fact: Parasitoid wasps exposed over life to illumination conditions
unresolved_gate: Indoor/outdoor setting and allocation not verified; lifetime fecundity not arthropod census
screening_note: Parasitoid wasps were exposed for life to darkness or two light levels; the abstract does not specify field versus indoor setting. Evaluate separately from abundance; egg laying/feeding are secondary endpoints.

reported_design_fact: Cricket individual activity/stridulation in outdoor enclosures, across 14 days
unresolved_gate: Same programme as preprint PPR:PPR753662 row 13; independent light allocation and response window unresolved
screening_note: Individual male crickets in outdoor enclosures were monitored for 14 days across intensities including below 0.01 lx. Review light-unit independence and endpoint; calling rhythm is distinct from catches.

reported_design_fact: Historical behaviour and urban/rural response to light
unresolved_gate: Separate observational historical association from any new randomized light contrast
screening_note: Compares historical behavioral records with urban/rural moth attraction experiments; check lighting allocation, test setting and dark comparator before assigning design.

reported_design_fact: Wild-collected larvae in controlled light test in autumn 2022 and spring 2024; blue/white reduced activity, red not
unresolved_gate: Dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15639247 found; Zenodo rights Copyright (not automatic CC); controlled behaviour not field abundance
screening_note: Spring and autumn tests report responses under different spectra and reduced movement. Abstract does not establish setting or control details.

reported_design_fact: Field dummy-female lure landing with multiple light colours and switched-off controls
unresolved_gate: Real lure×site×night allocation, variance and cross-colour dependence not yet checked; not general arthropod census
screening_note: A field study illuminated dummy females with four spectra or used switched-off controls, measuring number of landing males. Separate baited mate-attraction behavior from generic insect density.

reported_design_fact: 3 forests with shared 36 lit and 6 dark sampling plots; 306 of 307 shared ground records reconcile across two datasets
unresolved_gate: Must resolve plot/time clustering and cross-publication overlap; flight trap treatment/date conflicts remain HOLD
screening_note: Three Swiss forest sites over two summers compare LED properties and attraction. Check explicit dark-arm counts, trap effort and common plots with companion data.

reported_design_fact: Field traps combined with push-pull pest management
unresolved_gate: No light-only matched dark contrast verified; cannot attribute integrated system response to ALAN
screening_note: Ethiopian field trials varied night light traps and push-pull management. Determine whether a lights-only vs matched dark contrast is available and distinguish lethal trapping from ambient exposure.

reported_design_fact: Preprint and published study duplicate probable by exact title
unresolved_gate: Same field program as row 7, not a new experiment; verify manuscript version before coding effects
screening_note: Preprint describes individually enclosed crickets outdoors, with stridulation under varied illumination. Original abstract truncates numeric intensities; consult journal version.

reported_design_fact: Shore amphipod catches and direction associated with ALAN intensity, moon and cloud
unresolved_gate: Determine whether night-time illuminance was randomized at physical transects versus exposure gradient; record natural light controls
screening_note: Field study of shore amphipod catch and movement over an ALAN intensity range; verify exposure allocation and ambient control.

reported_design_fact: Protein succinylation under ALAN stress
unresolved_gate: Not arthropod abundance/activity-count endpoint; independent light containers unresolved
screening_note: ALAN-stressed moths and locomotion are mentioned, but whether movement was measured directly outdoors is unclear.

reported_design_fact: Lighting technology thesis; bat activity known, direct arthropod counts not confirmed
unresolved_gate: Obtain specific chapter; do not treat entire thesis as an experimental insect study
screening_note: Bat-lighting thesis includes streetlight retrofits; index abstract truncates before methods for possible insect outcomes.

reported_design_fact: Thesis on moths and host plants
unresolved_gate: Obtain chapter-level original programme IDs and dark-control variance; avoid citation double counting
screening_note: Thesis about moths, streetlight types and food plants; obtain chapter-specific comparator and experimental design.

reported_design_fact: Plant biomass and light×insect-exclusion study
unresolved_gate: Plants are the measured response; insect exclusion treatment alone is not insect abundance
screening_note: ALAN crossed with insect exclusion in plants; verify whether insects themselves were counted and retain plant endpoint separately.

reported_design_fact: 843 individual moths in 23 species with 10-lx and 1-lx light treatments; white and amber suppressed activity
unresolved_gate: Do not treat 843 individual moths as independent outdoor lamps or 23 species as different programmes
screening_note: Wild-caught moths tested against natural night illumination; ascertain whether flight activity was measured in field cages or indoors.

reported_design_fact: Floating traps across 4 spectra×2 intensities in a dark ditch
unresolved_gate: Confirm unlit reference trap and independent block layout; active phototaxis is not standing aquatic abundance
screening_note: Four spectral treatments at two intensities in a ditch; check methods for unlit controls versus active light-trap selectivity.

reported_design_fact: Streetlight-mediated plant toughness and herbivore performance
unresolved_gate: Growth/performance endpoint not insect abundance census; confirm light fixtures and plant-mediated contrasts
screening_note: Host plant and herbivore performance under streetlights; check manipulation, location and arthropod endpoint.

reported_design_fact: Before/after mercury-to-LED and comparison with existing LED/mercury/unlit bushland; insect biomass reportedly unchanged by retrofit
unresolved_gate: Not dark-to-lit randomized light effect; moonlight correlated with biomass; keep null and technology comparison separately
screening_note: Streetlight retrofit followed before/after with separate unlit habitat; verify comparator and allocation for insect biomass; retain reported null.

reported_design_fact: 8 river sites (7 Sangro/1 Zittola), 4 plate positions/site, 3-hour sampled nights; lit always follows dark; 21240 insects estimated via plate subsampling; near-lamp traps increase, distant not
unresolved_gate: 32 plates are not 32 independent ALAN interventions; original paired plate/site counts or covariance not retrieved; light-distance not wetness and treatment order confounded
screening_note: Riverbank lights manipulated across lit and unlit nights; insect catches measured by position.

reported_design_fact: Las Docas and Quintay field ambient/experimental lamp patches plus separate laboratory chambers
unresolved_gate: Behaviour/food-patch use distinct from census abundance; nested patches in arrays not physical lighting replicates
screening_note: Field lights versus ambient in sandy-beach amphipods, plus separate laboratory chambers; retain field activity endpoint.

reported_design_fact: 30 randomized light plots shared with Bennie 2018 plant experiment (6 plots per 5 regimes)
unresolved_gate: Do not add Davies publication as independent light programme; use one plot allocation and keep day/night/year repeated measures
screening_note: Three-year field LED manipulation monitored adult beetles and spiders; check plot replication, dark control and period.

reported_design_fact: Camera tracking under near-infrared/red/white light
unresolved_gate: Confirm near-infrared is dark comparator and controlled indoor/field setting; not abundance counts
screening_note: Camera observations of beetle movement under near-infrared, red and white radiation; confirm location and near-infrared control before assigning stratum.

reported_design_fact: Historical thesis on trap radius under night illumination and weather
unresolved_gate: Obtain original thesis chapters/design; avoid deriving dark contrast from active trap alone
screening_note: Historical field thesis on active moth light-trap capture and radius; verify an experimental lower-light/off comparator at chapter level.
